name: Panxo AI Monetization
author: panxoai

sections.description:
Panxo AI Monetization is an enterprise-grade WordPress plugin that automatically integrates AI-powered programmatic advertising into your website. With zero configuration required, the plugin handles everything from registration to script integration.

Key Features

  • Zero-Click Setup: Automatically registers your site, creates your property, and integrates the Panxo script
  • Automatic Script Integration: Injects the optimized Panxo script into your site header
  • ads.txt Management: Automatically updates your ads.txt file with required Panxo entries
  • Learning Phase Monitoring: Track your site’s learning progress directly from WordPress
  • Enterprise-Grade: Built with 50+ years of combined development experience
  • Privacy-First: No persistent cookies, GDPR/CCPA compliant

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. The plugin automatically registers your WordPress site with Panxo
  3. Your property is created and the learning process begins
  4. The Panxo script is automatically integrated into your site
  5. Your ads.txt file is updated with Panxo entries
  6. Monitor your learning progress from the WordPress dashboard

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active internet connection for API communication

External services

This plugin connects to Panxo’s external services for AI-powered advertising monetization. The connection to these services is required for the plugin to function.

Panxo API (api.panxo.ai)

The Panxo API handles automatic registration, property creation, script verification, and learning phase monitoring.

Data sent:
* Site domain (to create and identify your property)
* Admin email address (to create your publisher account)
* Publisher ID and Property ID (for authentication and status checks)

When data is sent:
* During initial plugin activation (automatic registration)
* When verifying installation status
* When checking learning phase progress
* When updating ads.txt configuration

Service documentation:
* Terms of Service: https://panxo.ai/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://panxo.ai/privacy/

Panxo CDN (cdn.panxo.ai)

The Panxo CDN delivers the optimized monetization script to your website visitors.

Data sent:
* No data is sent directly to the CDN. The script is loaded as a static resource.

When the script loads:
* On every page load when the plugin is active and enabled.

What the script does:
* Detects AI traffic sources (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.)
* Serves relevant advertisements to AI-referred visitors
* Sends anonymous analytics to Panxo (page views, ad impressions)

Service documentation:
* Terms of Service: https://panxo.ai/terms/
* Privacy Policy: https://panxo.ai/privacy/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Panxo AI Monetization”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin

Post-Installation

After activation, the plugin will automatically:
* Register your site with Panxo
* Create your property
* Integrate the Panxo script
* Update your ads.txt file
* Begin the learning process

No manual configuration is required!
sections.faq:
Do I need to configure anything?

No! The plugin handles everything automatically. Just install and activate.

How long does the learning phase take?

Typically 24-48 hours. You can monitor progress from the Panxo dashboard in WordPress.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The Panxo script is optimized for performance and loads asynchronously.

Is this GDPR/CCPA compliant?

Yes. Panxo is privacy-first and does not use persistent cookies.

Can I disable the plugin?

Yes. You can disable the plugin from Settings > Panxo in your WordPress admin.

What happens to my ads.txt file?

The plugin automatically adds Panxo entries to your existing ads.txt file, or creates one if it doesn’t exist.
